name: Facebook

changelog: Play shows no release notes for this update.

summary: The Facebook APK is the Android installer for Facebook, Meta's social network for friends, Groups, Marketplace, Reels and events. Google Play updated it on November 17, 2026, and the version varies by device. It's free with ads, and Facebook Lite is a smaller option for older phones.
metaDescription: Facebook APK download for Android: get the official Facebook app from Google Play, with install steps, security settings and fixes when it's not working.

faq.q: How do I download the Facebook APK?
faq.a: Install Facebook from Google Play, where the developer is Meta Platforms, Inc. Meta doesn't publish a Facebook APK on other websites, and unofficial copies are a common way to steal logins.

faq.q: What's the difference between Facebook and Facebook Lite?
faq.a: Facebook Lite is a much smaller app for older phones and slow connections, with the core features and simpler visuals. The full Facebook app has every feature but uses more storage, data and battery.

Usually it's the connection, an outdated app or a full cache. Update Facebook from Google Play, clear its cache in Settings → Apps → Facebook → Storage, and restart your phone. Meta outages also happen occasionally.

faq.q: Can I delete Facebook but keep Messenger?
faq.a: If you deactivate your Facebook account, you can usually keep using Messenger. If you permanently delete your Facebook account, your Messenger access goes with it.
Yes, if you protect your account. Turn on two-factor authentication, run Privacy Checkup, and never log in through links in messages promising prizes or account warnings.
